about.title: About The Untold Phrase
body: The Untold Phrase began as a corner of Instagram for writers who needed somewhere honest to place their words. Today it is a growing home for micro tales, poems, letters, and the lines that never made it into conversation.
We read every submission with care, celebrate select writers from our community, and keep the door open for new voices still finding their language.
At heart, TUP is simple: appreciate writers, share what was left unsaid, and leave readers with something that lingers.
bullets: Original poems, micro tales, and stories
about.imageAlt: Fountain pen writing on lined paper

founder.name: Shadwal Sinha
founder.title: Founder & Admin
bio: Shadwal Sinha runs The Untold Phrase — the community behind बातें कुछ अनकही सी. With roots in Varanasi and a background in IT, he built TUP into a home where budding writers can share poems, micro tales, and the lines that never made it into conversation.
He keeps the page focused on appreciating writers and leaving readers with something that lingers.

team.title: Founder, Natkhat Media
bio: Adarsh Yadav is the founder of Natkhat Media, a Varanasi-based marketing studio focused on social content, branding, and campaigns that get people talking.
With a background in social media marketing, he builds creative teams and brand stories — the kind of energy that helps communities like The Untold Phrase grow beyond the page.

anonymous.title: Anonymous Stories
anonymous.support: True stories you couldn’t say out loud — shared without a byline. We read every submission before it appears here.
anonymous.emptyTitle: Waiting for our first anonymous story
anonymous.emptySupport: Be the first to send something unsaid. No name required — only honesty.
guidelines: Share only what you have the right to tell; change names and details if needed.
No hate, harassment, or identifying someone against their will.
Keep it concise — a letter, a confession, a workplace almost-said.
We may lightly edit for clarity before publishing. Your name stays off the page.
anonymous.formNote: Submissions are reviewed before publishing. You will not be credited by name.

submit.title: Share your piece
submit.support: If a draft has been waiting in your notes, this is your invitation to send it.
guidelines: Keep pieces concise — micro tales, poems, letters, and short prose work best.
Submit original work you have the right to share; credit co-authors if any.
We may lightly edit for clarity or length before publishing, with credit to you.
We aim to reply when we can; Instagram DMs are also welcome at @theuntoldphrase.
submit.note: You can also send work through Instagram DM to @theuntoldphrase.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.support: Honest notes help us grow — tell us what feels right, and what we can do better.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: The Untold Phrase treats your details with care. When you use our submit, enquiry, or feedback forms, we use what you share only to reply and — with your consent — to publish credited work.
Anonymous story submissions do not require a name. We still receive the story by email for moderation before anything is published publicly.
Form submissions are delivered through FormSubmit to theuntoldphrase@gmail.com solely to reach our team. We do not sell personal information.
Our Instagram feed and insights use the Instagram API. Visiting Instagram or other third-party links follows their own policies.
On our hosted site we use Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights for anonymous page views and performance metrics — not advertising profiles.
Questions about your data or published pieces can be sent through the Enquiry page or Instagram @theuntoldphrase.
